title: Novel hybrid protein scaffold gap filling using weighted machine learning ensemble, beam search, and mass-constrained reranking
abstract: arXiv:2609.05436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein scaffold gap filling is an important computational task in protein sequence reconstruction, where missing amino acid regions must be inferred from incomplete scaffold information. This study proposes a hybrid machine learning and mass constrained reranking framework for protein scaffold gap filling under known-gap-size and known-gapmass settings. Homologous protein sequences from MabCampath, P5A proteoform, and carbonic anhydrase 2 were used to generate masked 11-mer residue-level samples and fullgap evaluation cases. The residue prediction task was formulated as a 20-class amino acid classification problem using first-, middle-, and last-position masking. Multiple classical machine learning models were trained using raw encoded, row-average, and SVD-reduced features, and the strongest models were combined through a validation-accuracy-weighted ensemble. translated_title: 基于加权机器学习集成、束搜索和质量约束重排序的新型混合蛋白质支架缺口填充方法
translated_abstract: 蛋白质支架缺口填充是蛋白质序列重建中的一项重要计算任务，需要根据不完整的支架信息推断缺失的氨基酸区域。本研究提出了一种混合机器学习与质量约束重排序框架，用于已知缺口大小和已知缺口质量两种设置下的蛋白质支架缺口填充。研究使用来自MabCampath、P5A蛋白质型和碳酸酐酶2的同源蛋白质序列，生成掩码的11聚体残基级样本和完整缺口评估案例。残基预测任务被表述为采用首位、中间位和末位掩码策略的20类氨基酸分类问题。研究使用原始编码、行平均和SVD降维特征训练了多个经典机器学习模型，并通过验证准确率加权集成的方式组合了表现最强的模型。对于已知大小的缺口重建，使用束搜索方法生成填补序列，并通过质量约束重排序对候选序列进行筛选优化。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种融合加权机器学习集成、束搜索和质量约束重排序的混合框架，用于解决蛋白质序列重建中已知缺口大小和质量条件下的支架缺口填充问题。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hybrid framework combining weighted machine learning ensemble, beam search, and mass-constrained reranking to address protein scaffold gap filling under known-gap-size and known-gap-mass settings in protein sequence reconstruction.
